vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: seo-content-pro
Version: 1.0.2

The skill is a comprehensive SEO content generation tool providing instructions for research, outlining, and drafting articles. It uses standard environment variables for configuration (e.g., CONTENT_TONE, SEARXNG_URL) and requires common utilities like python3 and curl for its operations. No malicious code, data exfiltration, or harmful prompt injections were found in SKILL.md or _meta.json.

llm.summary: The skill's requested tools and configuration are consistent with an SEO content generator; nothing obvious is asking for unrelated credentials or elevated privileges.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (SEO content, research, multi-language, scoring) align with the declared requirements: python3 and curl are plausible for local processing and fetching pages, and the SKILL.md describes using a SearXNG instance for research. No unrelated services or credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md is instruction-only and stays within SEO workflows (research top-ranked pages, outline, draft, scoring). Two cautions: (1) research uses a SearXNG URL — pointing that to an external/third-party instance will send your search queries and potentially page URLs to that remote service; (2) content-refresh features require users to paste existing articles, so sensitive/proprietary content could be processed and (depending on agent policies) transmitted — the skill itself does not declare extraneous data exfiltration steps, but the chosen SearXNG backend and the agent's network policy determine actual exposure.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only skills are low-risk from an installation perspective. Requiring python3 and curl is reasonable for runtime actions; nothing is downloaded or extracted by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No secrets or credential environment variables are required. Optional env vars are configuration-only (CONTENT_TONE, DEFAULT_LENGTH, CONTENT_LANGUAGE, SEARXNG_URL). The only potential concern is SEARXNG_URL: if set to an untrusted remote instance, queries and fetched page URLs could leak to that operator. This variable is declared and documented, so the request is proportionate but requires user attention.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and there is no indication the skill modifies other skills or system-wide settings. It relies on the agent invoking it when requested, which is normal.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent for SEO content generation. Before installing, check the following: (1) Confirm python3 and curl are available if you want the skill to run as intended. (2) Review SEARXNG_URL: prefer a local or trusted SearXNG instance; do not point it to unknown third-party hosts if you care about query privacy. (3) Avoid pasting sensitive or proprietary articles into the assistant if you do not want that text processed or potentially transmitted. (4) Because this is instruction-only, no code will be installed, but the agent may fetch web pages during research — ensure your agent's network policies and privacy settings meet your needs.
